meta.name: QQ Coffee · the site system
meta.title: One fluid size system for home, catalog and 25 coffee pages; round 3: the footer in squares, cards that are links, blocks that open, pages that flow
meta.lede: The whole system of the QQ Coffee site: 34 size roles drawn as lines from a 320 to a 1440 screen, three shared layout steps and the column at its most, one colour table with one line colour, one motion vocabulary, the 3D packs. Round 3 brought PT Mono and the animated flame, two square halves for the footer, whole-card links, a recommended row that runs to the screen's edges with cards rising in, new arrivals in two equal squares, info blocks that grow into a modal, eased fades everywhere and a card that opens its coffee in one move; the packs no longer tilt with the scroll. Measured at every 10px of width and 25px of height; «before» is round 2's build.
meta.footer: Measured in headless Chromium on the built sites, 2026-10-20. Before = round 2 (branch round-2, commit 7c5f586); now = branch round-3. Round 2's «before» was round 1's build, round 1's the Figma frames.

items.ask: 1. No tilt on scroll
items.done: The shelf lean (a tilt by the pack's place on the screen, up to 0.17 rad) and the lean with the scroll's speed (up to 0.45 rad) are gone: scrolling the page never tilts a pack. They still trail their slots a little (round 2) and turn towards the pointer.

items.ask: 1. The numbers block centred
items.done: The head is three columns from M: the title, the pager, the arrows; the pager's centre is 0px off the head's at every screen measured (before 448px at 1440). Below M it takes its own row, centred.

items.ask: 2. The card in two columns (the left one became larger sometimes)
items.done: Two tracks of minmax(0, 1fr), both squares, and the text square can no longer grow: its story is cut to the whole lines that fit (8 at 1440, 5 at 1024). Measured: two squares at every L screen (476 at 1024, 673 at 1440, all five slides). In Chromium round 2 measured even too, also with 20px browser text, so I could not see the larger left one: was it in Safari, or on the test site (still round 1)? Whatever made it grow is gone now.

items.ask: 3. The right column a photo, without a border
items.done: Every slide shows a photo: the coffee's own, else the next of four moodboard photos (a placeholder, decision featured-photos). The hairline is gone with the pack square.

items.ask: 4. The whole card a link
items.done: The name's link is stretched over the whole slide (text, taste box and photo); the caption lets clicks through. Measured: a click on the story, the pills, the photo and the caption opens the coffee.

items.ask: 5. The table evenly two columns
items.done: Two equal halves from M: 288 / 288 at 1440 (before 219 / 358), 256 / 256 at 1280. Two exceptions: below M the chart stands above the pills (a half of a phone can't hold the scales' names and the plot: it squeezed the plot); and on L's narrowest screens the chart keeps its size, so its half is a little wider (12px at 1000, 3 at 1024, 0 from 1030).

items.ask: 6. A magazine-like swipe: explore options in an artifact
items.done: Five options in a test bench: Новинки: листаем журнал (a stiff page turn, a bending glossy page, a slide-over, a pile, an editorial cut), each dragged by hand or played by the arrows, with a duration control and slow motion. Pick one and it goes on the site.

items.ask: 1. Packs tilt horizontally on sliding, lagging a bit behind
items.done: A pack's lag is now two parts: the page's scroll (it only trails) and its slot's own move on the page. When the row slides the pack trails and turns so its leading edge recedes, up to 0.55 rad at the full trail (TUNE.carryTurn), settling at 9 per second.

items.ask: 2. The wrapper should not crop the cards
items.done: The row runs out to the screen's edges (1440 wide at 1440 against a column of 1346), padded back, so its cards still stand and snap on the column (0px off it); 48px of room under the cards for them to rise.

items.ask: 3. The new card moves into place from below and from opacity 0; its pack tilts vertically and lags
items.done: Cards out of view wait 48px below (--section-gap) and clear; coming into view, when the row reaches the screen (one after another, 90ms apart) or sliding in, they rise over 0.9s (--t-rise) and fade in over 0.6s. Their pack is carried: it trails and tilts up (TUNE.carryTilt 0.45) and fades with its card (a new per-pack alpha in the renderer).

items.ask: 4. The price button: icon and text more transparent, the ground as it was
items.done: Hovered, the bag and the price go to ink 60% (white 60% on a photo card); the ground stays (before it filled with ink).

items.ask: 5. The favourite icon more transparent
items.done: Hovered, the heart goes to ink 60% (white 60% on a photo card).

items.ask: 6. The whole card, the text under it too, a link
items.done: The name's link is stretched over the whole card; nothing between them is positioned any more (the picture's layers share one grid cell). Measured on home, catalog and a coffee's page: the picture, the name and the text open the coffee; the heart, the weights and the price button keep their own clicks.

items.ask: 1. No top border
items.done: The hairline above the blocks is gone (the business section ends above them).

items.ask: 2. On click they grow into a modal with description and buttons (Figma)
items.done: Each block is one button. Pressed, a white ground grows from the block's box to the modal's (514px at 1440, 461 at 1024: --modal-w 360 → 520), the icon and the title travel to their places at the same size, the plus travels to the corner and turns into the cross; the text and «‹ Доставка | Оплата ›» fade in after (0.6s). The row steps to the other blocks; Esc, the cross or a click beside it shrinks it back into its block. On a phone a sheet at the foot. The roasting text is Figma's, with the next roast live («Ближайшая обжарка через 3 часа»).

items.ask: 1. On larger screens two square containers
items.done: From L two equal halves, each at least a square: square from about 1360 wide (673×673 at 1440, 759×759 at 1920); narrower the links need more height and both halves grow with them (599×626 at 1280, 476×603 at 1024).

items.ask: 2. At max width, borders on the left and right
items.done: From the column's 1520px (screens from about 1616) a hairline on each side, the copyright and the links standing off them.

items.ask: 3. The logo optically centred
items.done: The animated flame (your file, 27 KB gzipped, loaded lazily; its first frame with «reduce motion») is centred by its mass, measured over its whole animation: 50.5% across, 62.9% down its box. That lifts it by 12% of its height, as the Figma footer's 40px of a 320px logo. Its mass centre is 0px off the square's middle at every L screen.

items.ask: 4. The small texts properly aligned
items.done: One size, one colour (ink 70%) and one baseline: 0px apart (before 4px: the link had its own padding and underline).

items.ask: 5. «Политика конфиденциальности» without an underline
items.done: No underline; hovered it darkens to ink.

items.ask: 6. «Расскажем о появлении скидок и новинок» one line when there is room
items.done: The line and the field share a row while both fit, and the line keeps whole: one line at 24 of 25 screens (before 0); two only where the screen is narrower than the line.

items.ask: PT Mono and the logo animation (your files)
items.done: PT Mono Bold for every heading and name, cut to the text face's characters (13 KB; the ParaType Free Font Licence allows web use); the flame in the footer.

items.ask: All gradients eased (tw-easing-gradients): hero, product card, business card…
items.done: Every gradient is one of the eased fades of colors.json: 16 stops on CSS's standard «ease» (0.25, 0.1, 0.25, 1), the default of tw-easing-gradients; a new cloud fade for light cards. Changed: the card's buy row (was two stops), the business cards (two stops), the featured caption (two stops), the hero (was an S-curve). A new rule fails any hand-written fade.

items.ask: A card on a click transforms into the product page seamlessly (the title and the pack travel)
items.done: A cross-document view transition: the card's name becomes the page's title and its pack the big pack, travelling and growing over 0.6s while the pages cross-fade (0.45s); the way back does the same. The 3D canvas cannot be captured, so for that moment the packs show their stills, and the big pack arrives facing front. Chrome 126+ and Safari 18.2+; elsewhere the page simply opens.

blocks.title: What this changes that you may not expect
items: Every page change now cross-fades (0.45s), not only a card opening its coffee. With «reduce motion» there is no transition.
While a card rises into place (0.9s) its pack draws above its name and buy row: a moving, fading card is a layer of its own. At rest the layers are as before.
The footer is square only from about 1360 wide; at 1024–1350 the links need more than the square (476×603 at 1024).
Card descriptions under the cards are part of the link now, so their text can't be selected (it couldn't be drag-selected before either).
The new arrivals cut their story to fewer lines on narrow L screens (4–6 at 1024 instead of 8), so the text square stays square.
Below M the taste chart and the pills stack again (round 2 had them side by side from S, which squeezed the chart on a phone once the halves were made even).
Pages for the info blocks («Доставка», «Оплата») are not designed: the modal is the only place their text lives.
The 3D packs no longer lean when the page scrolls, so the shelf feeling is gone; the trail and the pointer turn remain.

sections.title: The system
sections.sub: design/scale.json: one range (320 → 1440), one ladder, roles with two ends. build/tokens.mjs writes one clamp() per role and checks the rules.

blocks.title: The ladder
blocks.sub: Steps of 2 up to 24, of 4 up to 64, of 8 up to 128, of 16 up to 256. Every end of every role sits on it (dots).

blocks.title: Text roles
blocks.sub: Value at 320 and 1440 (constant outside), the face, where it is used, and the Figma steps at 320 / 768 / 1280 / 1440 / 1920 where one exists.
rows: section headings, the catalog tabs, the product's name on its page
headings of the image blocks (approach, about)
the name of the featured coffee
names on product cards, titles of tiles (business, info blocks, product facts), footer headings
eyebrows above headings («Наш подход»): set apart by colour and case, not size
the big sentence of a product's story
the caption over the featured photo, the text under a section heading
longer text: the featured description, the story columns, business text
card descriptions, lists, links of the navbar and the footer, fields
descriptor pills, captions above values in the buy bar, the copyright
big actions and values set in bold capitals: hero links, «В корзину», buy-bar values
prices and weights on cards (medium capitals)

blocks.title: Levels that must stay apart
blocks.sub: The ratio of each pair at 320 (light) and at 1440 (dark). Two straight lines keep their ratio between its two end values, so the ends prove every size.

blocks.title: The height counts
blocks.sub: --vp = min(100vw, 2 × 100svh − 25rem): the width a screen counts as. 360 tall → the 320 sizes; 920 tall → the 1440 sizes.
blocks.note: The size a screen gets is the smaller of its width and this line.

blocks.title: Space and size roles
rows: side margin of every section: the content column starts here
space above and below a section's content
the tighter edge of a section that follows a related one (new arrivals → recommended)
from a section heading to its content
between rows of product cards (each card carries a description below it)
padding of big blocks: the featured text card, the text of image blocks, info blocks
padding of tiles: product facts, business descriptions, filter cells
height of the card's buy row and of big buttons
side padding of buttons and controls
padding above and below each row of the hero's cells (three rows: the roast's parts beside the three links)
the least photo the hero shows between the navbar and the fade into its cells
the eased fade from the hero's photo into the black of its cells
the most the hero may be tall: below it, the screen less a 24px peek (a tall portrait or 2560 screen stops here)
least height of the image blocks (approach, about)
width of the flame mark in the footer
width of a modal (an info block opened); under 40em (the tab bar's step) a modal is a sheet as wide as the screen
the 3D pack on a product page: the side of its square (also capped by the screen's height)

blocks.title: Colours
blocks.sub: design/colors.json; text pairs checked for contrast on every build.

sections.title: The navbar and the tab bar
sections.sub: Unchanged in round 3 (round 2 built it: four steps, the colours of the section under it, one max width with the column, a tab bar on phones). The table is round 2's measure, round 1 struck.

items.title: Steps
items.html: Every section in three groups from 64em (1024, the screen of L); «Каталог, Бизнесу, Журнал, Контакты» from 48em (768, the screen of M); the burger below; under 40em (640) the tab bar. In em, so bigger browser text takes the narrower step sooner. media.css: --links-full, --links, --phone.

items.title: Width
items.html: The bar's margin is 16px (the small gutter); its content min(100% − 2 × (16 − 8), --col-max + 2 × 8): the logo's and icons' boxes carry 8px of air, so the glyphs stand 16px from the edges, and on the column's edges once it is at its most (1616 and up).

items.title: Grounds
items.html: Sections say data-ground (paper, cloud, black, ink); it sets --g-bg, --g-fg, --line and --tint. The bar takes a ground once its whole height is over that section, crossing over in 0.6s; at the top of the page (and above it) the first section's. The tab bar does the same at the foot of the screen.

items.title: Hover
items.html: A tint behind the one item: --tint, white 20% on dark grounds, ink 6% on light ones. 0.2s in, 0.45s out. Nothing else on the bar changes.

items.title: Links
items.html: An item links only to a page that exists (data/site.json nav: a second value is the path). Today: «Кофе» and «Каталог». The rest are <a> without href: shown, not clickable, not in the tab order.

items.title: Tab bar
items.html: 56px + the safe area, four equal cells with icon and label (--type-small); the bag's count only. Everything fixed to the foot stands on it through --tabbar-h (the buy bar, the toast, the menu's height, the hero).

blocks.title: The navbar at 25 screens
blocks.sub: Step: what the bar shows. Icons: the tools in the bar. Logo / icon: how far the logo glyph and the last icon glyph stand inside the content column's edges (negative: outside it, in the gutter).

sections.title: The hero
sections.sub: The first screen of the home page. Round 3 changed only its fade (the «ease» curve) and its title's face (PT Mono). The table is round 2's measure, round 1 struck.

items.title: Height
items.html: min(100svh − 24 − tab bar, --hero-max), and never less than the navbar + --hero-photo (48 → 120) + --hero-fade (64 → 160) + the cells. --hero-max 960 → 1200 stops a portrait tablet or a 2560 screen (decision hero-height).

items.title: Rows
items.html: Below M the title, the countdown and the links stack. From M the countdown and the links share three equal rows (subgrid), title above; from L the title takes the first cell beside them. Row padding --hero-cell-y 12 → 20; texts trimmed to cap height and baseline.

items.title: Countdown
items.html: Everything as wide as the caption (13.9em of --type-control): the digits are control × 13.9 / 3 in tabular Technology (build/fonts.py), a date control × 13.9 / (0.65 × its letters) in mono. More than 24h to wait shows the date. Moscow time, the placeholder weekday schedule.

items.title: Frame
items.html: At the container step max (the column at 1520px) the cells get a hairline on each side and the title 48px of padding.

items.title: Fade
items.html: --fade-black: 16 stops along «ease», cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.1, 0.25, 1) (round 3; was 0.42, 0, 0.58, 1), from colors.json fades; over --hero-fade.

items.title: Entrance
items.html: The cells rise one section gap and fade in, 0.9s on --ease-out after 0.2s (--t-rise).

blocks.title: The hero at 25 screens
blocks.sub: Before (struck) and now. Peek: what shows of the next block under the hero, above the tab bar (negative: taller than the screen). Lines: the title. Digits / caption: their drawn widths. Align: the largest distance between a link's centre and its countdown part's (from M).

sections.title: New arrivals
sections.sub: One coffee at a time: a text square and a photo square, the pager in the middle of the head. New in round 3.

items.title: Halves
items.html: From L two tracks of minmax(0, 1fr), both aspect-ratio: 1; below L the text above the photo. The text square never grows: scripts/slider.js cuts the story to the whole lines that fit between the name and the taste box (--lines, at most 8).

items.title: Photo
items.html: The coffee's own photo, else the next of featured.photos (four moodboard photos, placeholder); its line over the eased black fade. No hairline beside it.

items.title: Head
items.html: From M three columns 1fr auto 1fr: title, pager, arrows; the pager is in the head's middle wherever the title and arrows are. Below M the pager has its own row.

items.title: Taste box
items.html: The taste chart and the pills in two equal halves from M (minmax(min-content, 1fr) minmax(0, 1fr): the chart never shrinks, so on 1000–1030 screens its half is up to 12px wider); below M the chart over the pills.

items.title: Link
items.html: The name's link stretched over the slide (::after, z-index 6); the caption above it lets clicks through.

items.title: Swipe
items.html: Still the ordinary scroll-snap row. A magazine-like turn is being chosen in the test bench.

blocks.title: New arrivals at 25 screens
blocks.sub: Text / photo: the widths of the two halves (one above the other below L). Heights: text / photo. Taste box: its two cells. Pager: its centre off the head's. Lines: the story's whole lines.

sections.title: The recommended row and the card
sections.sub: Round 3: the row runs to the screen's edges, cards rise into place, a card is one link, its hovers fade back.

items.title: Bleed
items.html: The row is widened by the column's margins and padded back (--bleed-l, --bleed-r, measured from the column by script), with scroll-padding the same: its cards stand and snap on the column, but slide out to the screen's edges. Without the script it is the column.

items.title: Rise
items.html: Out of view a card waits --section-gap below and clear ([data-wait]); in view it rises over --t-rise and fades over --t-move on --ease-out, the first ones 90ms apart. Not with «reduce motion».

items.title: Carried packs
items.html: A pack whose slot moves on the page (a sliding row, a rising card) trails it and tilts, leading edge away: carryTurn 0.55 sideways, carryTilt 0.45 up and down, at the full trail (12% of its height, ≤ 40px). The page's scroll only trails, never tilts.

items.title: One link
items.html: The name's link is stretched over .card; the picture's layers (photo, pack, name, buy row) share one grid cell, so nothing between is positioned. The heart and the buy row sit above it at z-index 7.

items.title: Hovers
items.html: The price button and the heart fade to --fg-soft (ink 60%, white 60% on a photo card); grounds stay.

items.title: Fade
items.html: The buy row stands on --fade: the cloud fade on light cards, the black one on photo cards (16 stops, «ease»).

blocks.title: The recommended row and the info modal at 25 screens
blocks.sub: Row: its width against the column (it runs to the screen's edges now). First card: its left edge off the column's. Modal: the opened box (width × height; a sheet on a phone).

sections.title: The info blocks and their modal
sections.sub: Three blocks that grow into one modal (Figma info-blocks-modal). New in round 3.

items.title: Blocks
items.html: Three buttons divided by hairlines (no line above them now): the icon, the title, the ringed plus (32px). Hover: the tint of the ground.

items.title: Modal
items.html: One <dialog> (focus held inside, Esc closes, focus back on its block): a box of --modal-w (360 → 520) over ink 20%; under 40em a sheet at the foot, as wide as the screen. Icon, title (the block's size), the text, the cross; «‹ prev | next ›» step to the other blocks.

items.title: Growing
items.html: The white ground grows from the block's box (an empty box may scale); the icon and title travel at their size; the plus travels and turns 45° into the cross; the text and the step row fade in after 30% of the 0.6s. All on --ease-out; back the same way into the block it shows.

items.title: Stepping
items.html: The panel slides out 24px and fades (0.23s), the next slides in (0.45s), the ground eases to the new height.

items.title: Live text
items.html: «Ближайшая обжарка через N часов» (or minutes, or the day when it is more than a day away) from the roast schedule, as the hero's countdown.

items.title: Without motion
items.html: With «reduce motion» it simply opens and closes.

sections.title: The footer
sections.sub: Two halves from L, the animated flame, the legal line. New in round 3.

items.title: Squares
items.html: From L two tracks of minmax(0, 1fr); the left half is aspect-ratio: 1 and stretches with the row, so both are square while the links fit (from about 1360 wide), taller where they need more.

items.title: Flame
items.html: Your SMIL file (one path, 109 shapes over 5s, 27 KB gzipped) as a lazy <img>; with «reduce motion» its first frame. --footer-logo wide (104 → 216).

items.title: Optical centre
items.html: The flame's mass centre, measured over its animation (50.5% across, 62.9% down its box), stands on the square's middle: translate(-50.5%, -62.9%). Its box's middle would set it 12% of its height low (the bowl is heavy, the tip thin).

items.title: Legal line
items.html: Copyright and policy: --type-small, ink 70%, one baseline (align-items: baseline), no underline; hover darkens the policy.

items.title: Newsletter
items.html: The line and the field in one row while both fit (the line flex: 1 1 max-content, the field from 16rem); else the line over the field, whole when it can be.

items.title: Frame
items.html: At the step max (the column at 1520) a hairline on each side, the texts standing off it by --tile-pad.

blocks.title: The footer at 25 screens
blocks.sub: Brand: the left half (width × height; a square from L where the links fit). Mass: how far the flame's mass centre stands from the square's middle (from L). Legal: the distance between the baselines of the copyright and the policy. News: the newsletter line's lines.

sections.title: The product stage and the buy bar
sections.sub: A coffee's page: the pack pinned while the fact tiles scroll past, the buy bar at the foot.

items.title: Pin
items.html: Height 100svh − navbar − buy bar (at least 22rem), pinned for as long as the five tiles take to pass; the tiles are 40% of the screen's height apart (28% from L), so scroll time is measured in screens (decision product-pin).

items.title: Pack
items.html: --stage 320 → 720, capped by the pin. It turns once around with qqStage.progress; tiles are frosted (cloud 70% + blur 40px) so the pack shows through them.

items.title: Arriving from a card (round 3)
items.html: Opened from a card, the page arrives in a view transition: the card's name becomes the title, its pack the big pack. The pack then starts facing front instead of turning in from a quarter turn.

items.title: Buy bar
items.html: Two rows of cells below L (options; quantity, price, «В корзину»), one row from L as in Figma. On a screen under 32em tall it waits after the stage instead of following the screen, which pins at the whole screen under the navbar (decision short-screens).

blocks.title: The product stage at 25 screens
blocks.sub: Pin: the pinned height. Pack: the 3D box. Under bar: how much of the pack box the buy bar covers. Bar: its height and rows ("after": past the stage on a short screen).

sections.title: The catalog

items.title: Filters

items.html: Things that belong together travel instead of appearing: a block becomes its modal (its icon, title and plus move; the ground grows), a card becomes its page (name and pack move). items.title: Colour

Layout steps only at S, M, L, max (and 64em, 48em, 40em, 32em tall)

Type levels ≥ ×1.125 apart at both ends
One line colour: borders only var(--line)
The navbar's sections never touch the logo or the tools (audit)
The countdown as wide as its caption (audit)
Every fade eased: gradients only var(--fade-*) or solid bands (round 3)
A whole card is its link; nothing positioned between the link and .card (round 3)
Things that belong together travel (block → modal, card → page) (round 3)
Waiting cards are data-wait; data-out is the filter's (round 3)
Links only to pages that exist
Fixed bars stand on the tab bar (--tabbar-h)
A hover changes only its own item
Every row that scrolls sideways is position: relative
3D canvas at z-index 5; what shows above packs ≥ 6
Links inside the site through href(ctx, to)
One heading level per section; names in mono, text in Apercu
Cells inside a block share hairlines (margin −1px), never double lines

blocks.sub: A separate agent that had not seen the round checked the built site against your comments, the rules and the three pages in a browser. Its findings and what was done about each:
items: Bug: Esc pressed twice while the modal grows left the page locked (no scroll, the block's icon and title hidden). fixed The tidying-up (scroll, the block, the focus) now runs on the dialog's close event, however it closes; an Esc while it is still moving is kept and done when it stops. Re-measured: after a double Esc the dialog is closed, the page scrolls 400 on a wheel of 400, the block shows, the focus is on it.

Bug: clicking a new arrival could fly a card of the same coffee in «Рекомендуем» (off the screen, still waiting to rise). fixed public/vt.js remembers the link clicked and names that slide or card; otherwise only a card on the screen and not waiting. Re-measured: the slide's name is the one named.

Bug: back to the home page nothing travelled (the page was at its top when the transition looked for the card). fixed On a step back vt.js puts the page at its saved place first, and home and catalog wait for their footer to be parsed before the first frame (<link rel=expect blocking=render>). A coffee's page left scrolled down names only what is on the screen. check Headless Chromium runs a transition on a step back only sometimes, so the way back needs a look in a real Chrome and Safari.
The reel cut a card's focus ring at its top. fixed 8px of room above the cards (padding with a matching negative margin).
At 1920 a fourth card rests in the right margin, outside the frame of the column. kept, a question It is what «not cropped» gives at rest; the question is in Next.
Scratch scripts were committed at the repo root. removed and ignored.
The dialog's name was the same for all three panels. fixed aria-labelledby points at the shown panel's title.

Nits fixed stale comments (motion.css, the card's comment, the canvas label, the modal width's note in scale.json); the footer decision's 1280 numbers (599 × 626); the filled heart now eases its hover colour; the story's line fit lost its 1px tolerance (the last slide at 1024 overflowed by 1px); the slide's focus ring has a white line inside the ink one, so it shows on the photo. open two slides share the jacket photo (a photo per coffee, in Next).

items.done: The bar's own margin is 16px at every width (the gutter of a 320 screen), the glyphs 16px from the screen's edges (before 12 → 44 with the gutter).

items.ask: 4. [additional padding]
items.done: Read together with 5: the 8px of air inside the logo's and the icons' boxes is counted in the max width. Tell me if you meant something else.

items.ask: 5. Max width, systematic, counting the logo's and icons' padding
items.done: The content stops at --col-max + 2 × 8px (1536): from a 1616 screen on, the logo glyph and the last icon glyph stand exactly on the column's edges (measured: 0px off at 1680, 1920 and 2560; before 36, 156 and 476px outside).

items.ask: 6. Add profile icon
items.done: A profile icon in the set's 1.5px line, after the bag (and in the tab bar). It leads nowhere yet: there is no profile page.

items.ask: 7. Max width for the inner container, systematic with other max widths
items.done: The same width as 5: .nav__in is the content column (1520) plus the 8px of air on each side. One max width for everything on the page.

items.ask: 8. Colour by the section behind, smoothly, once fully on it
items.done: Every section says its ground (data-ground: white, cloud, black, cool grey) and the bar takes its colours once its whole 48px stand on that section; while a boundary crosses the bar it keeps its colours. They cross over in 0.6s (--t-move). Measured on the home page: black over the hero, white over the coffees, black over «Наш подход», white over «О компании», cool grey over business, white over the facts. The tab bar follows the section at the screen's foot the same way.

items.ask: 9. Smaller sizes: short links, then the burger, then a bottom menu
items.done: Four steps: every section from 64em (1024), «Каталог, Бизнесу, Журнал, Контакты» from 48em (768), the burger below, and under 40em (640) the favourites, bag and profile leave for a tab bar at the foot with «Каталог, Корзина, Избранное, Профиль». The widths are the screens of the column steps L and M, where each row fits with room to spare (the sections 584px + two outer columns of 172px at 1024; the short ones 288 + 2 × 172 at 768). The audit now fails if the sections touch the logo or the tools.

items.ask: 10. Links to pages, not anchors; no page, no link
items.done: Only «Кофе» and «Каталог» link (to the catalog). Каскара, Дрипы, Сеты, Кофейням, Офисам, Бизнесу, Журнал, Контакты, search, favourites, bag and profile are labels without a link (<a> without href) until their page exists; each becomes a link by adding its path in data/site.json (decision nav-links-pages). The hero's and the footer's links are unchanged: should the same rule apply there?

items.ask: 11. Scrolling above the page turns it white
items.done: Above the top (a touchpad or phone bounce) the bars keep the first section's ground (black on the home page), and the page behind the bounce is that colour too: the top half of the page bounces in its first ground, the bottom half in its last (the footer's cloud). A real bounce cannot be made in a headless browser: please check on your Mac and phone.

items.ask: 12. A counter only on the bag
items.done: The favourites count is gone (navbar and tab bar); the bag keeps its lavender count.

items.ask: 1. Height: full minus 24px; a system of min and max
items.done: The screen less 24 (less the 56px tab bar on a phone), at most --hero-max (960 → 1200: a portrait tablet, a 2560 screen), and never less than the cells, the fade (--hero-fade 64 → 160) and a strip of photo (--hero-photo 48 → 120) need. Measured: 876 at 1440 × 900 (was 800), 1056 at 1920 × 1080, 744 at 1024 × 768, 764 at 390 × 844; 1067 at 820 × 1180 and 1200 at 2560 × 1440 (the max). Short phones get the content's height: 638 at 320 × 568.

items.ask: 2. Ease the black gradient
items.done: An eased fade in 16 stops along an S-curve (cubic-bezier 0.42, 0, 0.58, 1), as tw-easing-gradients, generated into --fade-black from colors.json; 160px tall at 1440 (was 48px, two stops). The featured photo caption and the business cards use the same fade.

items.ask: 3. All texts in the three blocks trimmed
items.done: text-box: trim-both cap alphabetic on the title, the day row, the digits, the caption and the links: each row's padding is the space you see (12 → 20px). Chrome and Safari 18.2+; Firefox keeps the line's air.

items.ask: 4. Title always three lines
items.done: Word under word, at every width: 3 lines at all 25 screens measured (before 1 or 2 lines below 1024).

items.ask: 5. The middle block in three containers, aligned with the three links
items.done: From M the countdown and the links share three equal rows (CSS subgrid): the day and the time beside «Каталог», the digits beside «Бизнесу», the caption beside «Контакты». Centres within 0px at every screen measured (before 3–13px off). Rows are as tall as the digits need: 104px at 1440.

items.ask: 6. Left and right border on the inner container from a max width
items.done: A new container step max (1520px: the column at its most). From there the cells are framed by a hairline on each side and the title stands 48px off the left one. 1440 has none; 1680, 1920 and 2560 have them.

items.ask: 7. Hover on the links
items.done: The link's whole cell gets the hover tint (white 20%), and the arrow keeps its 6px nudge.

items.ask: 8. Elements as wide as «ДО БЛИЖАЙШЕЙ ОБЖАРКИ»
items.done: The caption is 13.9em of the control size; the day row is that wide, the digits are sized to it (control × 13.9 / 3), and the countdown font is now tabular (every digit as wide as «0»), so it is exactly as wide every second: 275 = 275 at 1440, 200 = 200 at 390. The audit checks it at every size (decision countdown-as-caption).

items.ask: 9. More than 24h to wait: the date and «До ближайшей обжарки»
items.done: From Friday 10:00 to Sunday 10:00 (with the placeholder weekday schedule) the digits give way to the date of the next roast, «ПН, 26 ОКТ», in the mono of the headings (Technology has no Cyrillic), sized by its letters to the caption's width; screen readers hear «Следующая обжарка в понедельник, 26 октября».

items.ask: 10. On load the bar rises in from opacity 0 and from below
items.done: The cells rise one section gap (24 → 48px) and fade in over 0.9s on --ease-out, 0.2s after the page opens (--t-rise, new). Not with «reduce motion».

items.ask: Always cool gray 20% on light and white 30% on dark
items.done: One --line, set by each section's ground: ink 20% on white and cloud, white 30% on black and cool grey. Changed: the navbar's line (ink 10% → 20%), the hero's (white 40% → 30%), the featured pack square and the product lots (ink 10%), arrows, fields and the catalog panel (#d5d5d6 or ink). A new rule in build/rules.mjs fails any border that is not var(--line); only states (the current pager dot, a focused field) may draw in ink, and drawn marks (the weight dot, a chevron) in currentColor.

blocks.title: What this changes that you may not expect
items: The hero is taller than the screen on small and sideways phones: 638 at 320 × 568 (it was 555), 549 at 844 × 390 (was 376) — three title lines and a countdown as wide as its caption take more room. From 390 × 844 up it is the screen less 24.
Most navbar items lead nowhere now (no page behind them): only «Кофе» / «Каталог» are links. On a phone, «Корзина», «Избранное», «Профиль» in the tab bar do nothing yet.
At 1024–1600 the navbar's logo no longer lines up with the content column (it stands at 16px; the column at the gutter, up to 48px): that is the «small» padding. From 1616 on they line up.
The navbar on light grounds hovers in ink, not white (white would be invisible on white).
On a phone the page ends 56px lower (the tab bar's room under the footer), and the product's pinned stage is 56px shorter.
The countdown is a little smaller than before at 1440 (93 instead of 96px): its size now follows the caption.

items.ask: Build the QQ Coffee website from the Figma file, hosted on GitHub

items.ask: Start with the main, catalog and product pages; other pages only as context
items.done: Home, catalog and one page per coffee (25), from one set of components. Not built: bag, checkout, search, favourites, account, other categories, journal, business pages (see Next).

items.ask: Figma is general inspiration, not exact values or structure
items.done: Sizes come from the site's own scale; structure follows Figma (sections, cells, hairlines, mono capitals). Where Figma differs between frames, the site takes one line through them: e.g. h2 32→48 where Figma has 32 / 36 / 40 / 48 steps.

items.ask: A fluid system, not breakpoints (exceptions allowed)
items.done: Every size is a straight line from its value at 320 to its value at 1440 (31 roles in design/scale.json), constant outside; the screen's height counts (a screen 360 tall gets the 320 sizes, 920 tall the 1440 sizes). Layout changes at only three shared column steps S 22rem, M 43rem, L 58rem, plus the navbar at 64em. Four exceptions use screen units on purpose, listed in decisions.json.

items.ask: A system within pages and between screen sizes
items.done: One ladder (steps 2/4/8/16), type levels ≥ ×1.125 apart at both ends, colours only from design/colors.json with contrast checks, one motion vocabulary; build/rules.mjs checks 9 rules on every build and in CI.

items.ask: Flow Medium's size system as inspiration

blocks.title: Where the site departs from Figma, or does something you may not expect
items: Headings are JetBrains Mono, not PT Mono: narrower, with a different «Ж» and «Ш». A licence for PT Mono Bold swaps it in one line.
Sizes in between Figma frames are not Figma's: the site draws one line through each role, so e.g. the hero title is 55 at 1024 where Figma would show 56 (768 frame) or 64 (990 frame).
The countdown is 96 at 1440 and above, where Figma's 1920 frame has 128: nothing grows past 1440.
Figma's featured slide has a photo; the site shows the 3D pack unless data/site.json names a photo for that coffee.
On a phone sideways the hero is taller than the screen (555 px at 568 × 320): the title, the countdown and three links stack in one column below M.
The photos are Figma's moodboard, several with other roasters' packs: to replace before launch.
